candidates.change_summary: Modify the nonReentrant_ modifier to omit setting locked_ = true before function body, allowing reentrancy into Put and changing post-Put state observable via Put.
Change Put to set acc.unlockTime to the provided _unlockTime without clamping to block.timestamp, allowing unlockTime to be earlier and affecting subsequent Put-observed state.
Replace the external call to msg.sender.call with a send that forwards 2300 gas (transfer-style) by using payable(msg.sender).transfer, changing reentrancy and failure behavior.
Modify the nonReentrant_ modifier to set locked_ = false before executing the function body (allowing reentrancy during the protected call), changing observable behavior of Collect.
Change the condition that checks unlock time from strictly greater to greater-or-equal, allowing Collect to succeed earlier or in more cases.
